detail: NBA: markets and picks are withheld for 42 fixtures because the smallest per-team sample is under 20 completed games, so no line can be originated. The prior-season stats endpoint (stats.nba.com) timed out from the build runner and the schedule CDN carries only the current season, which is why the sample is this small. The fixtures, records and official source links are still published.
MLB: the official feed returned no fixtures inside the publishing window
